issues.t: bedrock-runtime InvokeModel malformed-body refusal carries an emulator-authored message instead of AWS's fixed malformed-input sentence
bedrock-runtime refusal messages are re-worded by the emulator: malformed InvokeModel JSON body and Converse toolResult with an unknown toolUseId (2 causes)
bedrock-runtime data plane applies no authorization gate: InvokeModel/Converse keep succeeding for a principal with no bedrock:InvokeModel grant (1 cause)
bedrock-runtime InvokeGuardrailChecks scores diverge: prompt-attack severity and category order, and PII confidenceScore is a quantized f32
bedrock-runtime inference envelope: token usage is recomputed wrongly, usage.serverToolUsage omitted, and InvokeModel ignores max-token truncation
bedrock-runtime error paths diverge: wrong status and code on async-invoke refusals, invalid input accepted 200, re-worded validation messages

bedrock-runtime: Converse/InvokeModel generation is a constant notice string, out-of-range InvokeModel temperature is accepted with 200, and two validation refusals use the emulator's own wording (ListAsyncInvokes nextTo
Converse/ConverseStream ignore inferenceConfig.stopSequences: the served completion is never truncated at a configured stop sequence

bedrock-runtime synchronous and async inference input validation is over-permissive: empty Message.content, out-of-range temperature and context-window-exceeding payloads are all accepted with 200, and async jobs still n
InvokeGuardrailChecks is over-permissive: VIOLENCE/MISCONDUCT content filters always score 0.0, and the PII recognizer misses a seven-digit local PHONE number
Converse/ConverseStream toolUse block carries an empty input document: the tool's declared arguments are never populated
Converse with a mandatory toolChoice mints no toolUse block (stopReason 'end_turn'), so the cross-turn toolUseId contract on ToolResultBlock is never enforced
InvokeModelWithResponseStream on a live Nova model emits the unary body as a single chunk: no messageStart/contentBlockDelta/contentBlockStop/messageStop event sequence
bedrock-runtime ApplyGuardrail answers the unmodeled code NotImplemented where AWS answers 400 ValidationException for a nonexistent guardrailIdentifier
bedrock-runtime inline-guardrail error taxonomy: ApplyGuardrail and InvokeGuardrailChecks answer the unmodeled code NotImplemented where AWS answers 400 ValidationException
Converse accepts a cachePoint content block and ignores it: TokenUsage never reports cacheWriteInputTokens/cacheReadInputTokens
bedrock-runtime synchronous inference: guardrailConfig and toolConfig silently ignored, no authorization gate, response stream is a single frame, wrong not-found class
Implement bedrock-runtime InvokeGuardrailChecks: unimplemented scaffold stub
